resources.string: If you agree, Levik VPN will periodically check mobile network availability and send the results to Levik servers, including while the app is closed. A request outside the VPN exposes your mobile IP address to Levik to estimate your region. Reports contain a short-lived region token, network type and availability result. They are used to build the regional Internet allowlist map. No account or device identifier is attached to these reports. Regional aggregates are retained for up to 90 days. This is optional: declining does not prevent VPN use. You can stop reporting in Settings.

If you agree, Levik VPN will periodically contact the services listed in Diagnostics and send their reachability, response times and measurement time to Levik servers, including while the app is closed. Levik and the checked services see the IP used for those requests; Levik also receives the device identifier derived from the Android Keystore key, technical request signature and app request headers. These results help diagnose Internet restrictions. This does not send your browsing history. Participation is optional and can be disabled in Settings without stopping the VPN.

Android location permission lets Levik VPN read the connected Wi-Fi network name (SSID). The app compares it with your trusted networks to start the VPN on untrusted Wi-Fi, including while a VPN session runs in the background where Android permits access. Network names and your trusted list stay on this device and are not sent to Levik. GPS coordinates are not requested. You can decline and connect the VPN manually, or turn this feature off in Settings.
Optional regional network reports. Sent only after your consent.
Optional background connectivity checks and reports to Levik. Requires your consent.

Levik VPN reads the list of installed apps, including system apps such as Android Auto, so you can choose which apps use or bypass the VPN. App names, icons and package identifiers are used locally for this selection and to label per-app traffic counters and are not sent to Levik or used for advertising. Without access you can still use the VPN for all apps.
Choose apps, including system apps, to use or bypass VPN. The installed app list stays on this device.
